target.reason: Petersburg predates the Istanbul `chainid` opcode and is accepted by every supported solc.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc rejects `let chainid := 1` on Petersburg on every version (DeclarationError 5017): `chainid` is a target-gated built-in whose name stays reserved even where the opcode does not exist yet. slang only rejects a built-in name where the built-in is *available*, so it accepts the declaration here. Reserving names that are not yet available needs a separate reserved-identifier check; remove this divergence once that lands.
